title: Water Rotation Log Weekly Days Since Rotation Trend
dataSources: Go-bag inventories (`gobag:inventory`), prep drills (`prep:drill`), water rotation logs (`water:rotation`), battery expiration checks (`battery:expiration`), and radio tests (`radio:test`).
app: Go-bag inventory audits, household prep drill logs, water rotation schedules, battery expiration trackers, and emergency radio test results streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=water:rotation days_since_rotation=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(days_since_rotation) as avg_duration, max(days_since_rotation) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst days since rotation for water rotation log events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture days_since_rotation on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average days since rotation with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It reminds whether water rotation log tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
